description: The business lifecycle (packages/core/docs/business-lifecycle.md §3): what a trade costs to open here, what a day of it costs to run, what its posts bring in, and the day the doors do not open again. Each kb mirrors packages/core/src/business/business-predicates.ts verbatim and is regenerated by `npm run business-corpus`. The pack is a COMPOSITION pack over the trade half of the equipment module: it reads business_owner/2 and vendor/2 and defines clauses for neither, and the cases here declare every adopted predicate dynamic themselves, exactly as the shipped pack does, which is what lets them run standalone. Every number is an integer coin and there is no percentage anywhere in the pack — a margin is vendor_markup/2’s and belongs to the layer that prices things — and, unlike the v1 mechanic this replaces, there is NO ROLL: should_found_business/1 fired on random_chance(0.05) and should_close_business/1 on random_chance(0.02), a coin flip: one host-side seeded draw per call (conformance/prolog/pack-agreement.json), so the v1 lifecycle replayed only under the host’s seed and draw order and no rule could say why a shop shut. Solvency is the TILL against the outgoings and never the profit, which is what lets a shop lose money for a month and still be open; ruin is consecutive days in arrears against the world’s own ruin_grace/1, so a world that authored no patience ruins nobody. What is NOT here is a price, a stock level or a shelf: those are conformance/prolog/mechanic-equipment.json’s, and that a purchase is gated like any other action is proved there. Neither is the gate on founding: whether a person MAY open a shop is one more clause of forbids/4, permissible/3 belongs to conformance/prolog/agent-ai.json, and that a refused founding writes nothing at all is proved end to end in packages/core/src/game-engine/logic/__tests__/BusinessDirector.test.ts.

cases.name: a-bare-kb-has-no-business-and-does-not-raise
kb: business_sum([X | T], S) :- business_sum(T, S0), S is S0 + X.
business_staff(B, Who, Role) :- employed_at(Who, B, Role).
business_post_open(B, Role) :- business_trading(B), business_type(B, T), trade_post(T, Role), \+ employed_at(_, B, Role).
business_upkeep(B, Cost) :- nonvar(B), business_type(B, T), trade_upkeep(T, Cost), !.
business_wage_bill(B, Total) :- business(B), findall(W, (employed_at(_, B, Role), post_wage(Role, W)), Ws), business_sum(Ws, Total).
business_yield(B, Total) :- business(B), findall(Y, (employed_at(_, B, Role), post_yield(Role, Y)), Ys), business_sum(Ys, Total).
business_outgoings(B, Total) :- business_upkeep(B, Upkeep), business_wage_bill(B, Wages), Total is Upkeep + Wages.
business_profit(B, Profit) :- business_yield(B, In), business_outgoings(B, Out), Profit is In - Out.
business_solvent(B) :- business_capital(B, C), business_outgoings(B, Out), C >= Out.
business_draw(B, Owner, Profit) :- business_owner(B, Owner), business_profit(B, Profit), Profit > 0.
